# Visual Studio Code GUI Interface Description

## Window Header and System Information

- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "Visual Studio Code" as the application name.
- **System Information Bar**: Located at the top center, shows the date and time "Oct 23 01:47".
- **System Tray Icons**: Located at the top right, includes icons for:
  - Network connectivity
  - Sound/volume control
  - Power button
- **Window Control Buttons**: Located at the top right, includes:
  - Minimize button (dash icon)
  - Maximize button (square icon)
  - Close button (X icon)

## Application Menu Bar

- **Menu Items**: Located at the top left, includes:
  - File
  - Edit
  - Selection
  - View
  - Go
  - Run
  - Terminal
  - Help

## Left Sidebar (Activity Bar)

- **Explorer Icon**: Folders and file explorer icon.
- **Search Icon**: Magnifying glass icon for searching within the project.
- **Source Control Icon**: Branch and commit icon for version control.
- **Run and Debug Icon**: Play and bug icon for running and debugging code.
- **Extensions Icon**: Grid icon for managing extensions.
- **Activity Bar Icons (Vertical List)**:
  - Chrome browser icon
  - Thunderbird email client icon
  - Visual Studio Code icon
  - VLC media player icon
  - LibreOffice Writer icon
  - LibreOffice Calc icon
  - LibreOffice Impress icon
  - GIMP image editor icon
  - File manager icon
  - Software center icon
  - Help icon (question mark)
  - Trash bin icon
- **Bottom Left Icons**:
  - User profile icon
  - Settings gear icon with a notification badge (number 1)
  - Outline and Timeline sections (collapsed)

## Main Content Area

- **Tab Header**: Displays "Welcome" with a close button (X) next to it.
- **Welcome Page Title**: "Visual Studio Code" in large font.
- **Subtitle**: "Editing evolved" in smaller font.
- **Start Section**:
  - **New File...**: Icon of a document with a plus sign.
  - **Open File...**: Icon of an open document.
  - **Open Folder...**: Icon of a folder.
  - **Connect to...**: Icon of a network connection.
- **Recent Section**:
  - Text: "You have no recent folders, open a folder to start."
- **Walkthroughs Section**:
  - **Get Started with VS Code**: Blue star icon, text "Customize your editor, learn the basics, and start coding", with a blue progress bar underneath.
  - **Learn the Fundamentals**: Light bulb icon, text "Learn the Fundamentals".
- **Checkbox**: "Show welcome page on startup" with a checked box.

## Bottom Status Bar

- **Status Indicators**: Located at the bottom left, includes:
  - Git branch indicator (with 0 commits ahead and 0 behind)
  - File encoding indicator (UTF-8)
  - Line and column indicators (0, 0)
- **Notification Icon**: Located at the bottom right, includes a bell icon.

## Explorer Panel

- **Panel Title**: "EXPLORER" in uppercase.
- **Project Folder**: "PROJECT" with a folder icon, expanded.
- **Files in Project**:
  - "calculator.py" with a Python file icon.
  - "README.md" with a Markdown file icon.
  - "test_calculator.py" with a Python file icon.
- **More Options Button**: Ellipsis (...) button next to the "EXPLORER" title.

## Additional UI Elements

- **Window Layout Button**: Located at the top right of the main content area, includes two vertical bars for toggling layout.
- **More Options Button**: Located at the top right of the main content area, includes three dots for additional options.
